locator.text: Display 104.2, p. 104, in the proof of Proposition 9.3

evidence: paper: \int_0^{\delta} s^{-M} e^{-a/s^2}\,ds \le C_{M,a}\,\delta^{3-M} e^{-a/\delta^2}, \qquad \left|\frac{d^k}{ds^k} e^{-a/s^2}\right| \le C_{k,a}\, s^{-3k} e^{-a/s^2}.

provenance.note: machine audit, checked by a second agent; not confirmed by a human

verdicts.summary: Lean uses a different formula here. Lean gives the integral as an exact identity e^(-a/x²) x^(3-j) F(x), F smooth, j a natural number, and bounds the derivatives with one uniform non-sharp exponent in place of 3k.
